method.unit: complete simulated week, paired by the exact predeclared seed
method.unseenDeclaration: All12 cryptographically random seeds reserved after confirmation and before any play. Neither this panel nor earlier fresh panels is used to tune this frozen candidate while called unseen.

bootstrap.method: percentile interval for mean profit difference; resample whole paired weeks

method.signTest: two-sided exact binomial sign test, excluding ties
method.qualificationBound: one-sided 95% exact binomial lower bound; requires independent identically distributed weeks
method.onTimeDefinition: Every noncancelled order leg must arrive by its deadline; private delivery uses min(order deadline, booked slot end + 30 minutes). Snapshot counts and ledger totals must reconcile to official scores.
limitations: A small panel cannot establish a very low disqualification probability.
Bootstrap intervals are descriptive small-sample estimates, not guarantees.
All declared weeks remain in mean profit, including unqualified weeks.
No outcomes are discovered by label or selected by performance; only exact manifest world IDs are opened.
Do not tune against these outcomes and continue calling the same panel unseen.
